calibration.tokens: inputTokens/cacheReadTokens/outputTokens are cumulative request volumes (audit §4.1), not context residency.
calibration.llm_window_ms: sum over steps of (first assistant/message time - step/start time); raw two-timestamp deltas — TTFT vs decode NOT separable (the trace model has no first-token event); reported as one window.
calibration.tool_time_ms: sum of paired tool/call->tool/result timestamp deltas; executions happen inside steps after the assistant message, so the llm window and tool time do not overlap by construction.
calibration.other_residual_ms: turn total - llm - tool: a labeled arithmetic residual (harness gaps, uninstrumented waits) — never attributed to a single cause (audit §4.3/§4.4).
calibration.user_wait: ask_user_question call->result suspension (user think time) is inside turn totals and reported separately as ask_suspended_ms.
calibration.ttfa: raw event-timestamp deltas — 按事件时间戳原始值报告，不加工不推算 (audit §4.3).
calibration.governance_tools: name-based classification, deliberately minimal: ask_user_question, skill — generic tools (read/pwsh/...) cannot be classified by name and count as work-tool candidates.
